pages.name: Sicilian: Najdorf, Main Line, 10.g4 b5
pages.notes: Plan 2 had ...Rfc8 before Black has castled. Rewrote plan 2 around ...b4, ...Bb7 and ...Rc8.

pages.name: Sicilian: Najdorf, Main Line, 10.g4 b5 11.Bd3 Bb7
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed g5 with White's own bishop on g5 (reviewer); plan 2 had an ...a5-a4 route and ...Rxc3 with no rook on the c-file. Rewrote both plans; British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Sicilian: Najdorf, Main Line, 10.Qg3
pages.notes: Plan 1 had a g-pawn storm with the queen on g3 blocking the pawn (reviewer); plan 3 had a ...b5-b4 route. Rewrote plan 1 around e5, Bxf6 and sacrifices on b5 or e6; reworded plan 3.

pages.name: Sicilian: Najdorf, Main Line, Keres, 13.Qg3
pages.notes: Plan 2 had ...Rxc3 with no rook on the c-file. Reworded plan 2.

pages.name: Sicilian: Najdorf, Modern Main Line 13.f5 Bxg5+ 14.Kb1 Ne5
pages.notes: Plan 1 had g6 with no white g-pawn and missed the main 15.Qh5 and the Nxe6 sacrifice (reviewer). Rewrote plan 1.

pages.name: Sicilian: Najdorf, Modern Main Line 13.f5 Nc5
pages.notes: Plan 3 had Kh1 with the king on c1. Rewrote plan 3.

pages.name: Chigorin Variation, 3...Nc6
pages.notes: Plan 1 had f4-f5 with the knight on f3 and 0-0 notation; plan 2 had a ...b5-b4 route; plan 4 had White castle long to support the centre. Rewrote plans 1, 2 and 4; British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: French Defense: Diemer-Duhm Gambit
pages.notes: The overview said 3.c4 sacrifices the c-pawn, though the gambit is the e4-pawn after 3...dxe4 4.Nc3 Nf6 5.f3; plan 2 had White castle long. Rewrote the overview and all four plans.

pages.name: French Defense: Knight Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 named exd5 before ...d5; plan 4 called queenside expansion a minority attack. Rewrote plans 1 and 4; British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: French Defense: Pelikan Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 had a rook lift Rf1-f3-g3 with the bishop still on f1. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling in the overview and plan 3.
